notes.title: Changing the date
notes.notes:
[b]  hi everyone [/b] i'm glad you're reading this and it means a lot to me
I decided to postpone the UTS release date to 07/01/2022, since there is a war in my country 🇺🇦 and it has become more difficult to develop the game, don't worry, the game will be available soon)))

I will share with you a few shots from the development


[b]
made the initial set of workbenches In the image there are 3 levels of the workbench with different variations, I do not like it when the buildings look the same I have to build many workbenches to optimize the work in my settlement[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42080912/bb08cfd1b737ae5e89856762bcef41cde7d19e1f.png[/img]

  [b]We also recently finished making beds, there will be 6 levels of them, they will differ in characteristics.
  What will affect your settlers in the first place is convenience.
The mood of your settlers will depend on the characteristics of the bed.
  How many leadership points a resident will give you depends on the mood.
  For leadership points, it will be possible to open new items, buildings, building improvements in the development tree.
  You will also need leadership points to construct buildings.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42080912/a5d149bc4df960e0881d65c2213dc2b46ca7a6f2.png[/img]

notes.title: Under The Sky character customization demo
notes.notes:
In this video I'll show you a demo version of character customization in Under The Sky [b]THIS IS NOT THE FINAL RESULT!!!![/b] but he will be the same accessor in the early access of the game.
You can completely make yourself any hero without restrictions, give him a name and also come up with the name of your colony, choose any graphite from those provided, graphite will show where your territory is on the roof and you can also use it to capture new roofs and increase your territory
